claims.sql: SELECT 100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN renewables_share_elec END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2015 THEN renewables_share_elec END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2015 THEN renewables_share_elec END) FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel'
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
